feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 September 2026 4:12pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Norwegian Sea will track northeast, as a transient ridge of high pressure builds overnight.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 at first, decreasing 3 or 4 later tomorrow morning, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 through the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming isolated overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, increasing southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 tomorrow evening, veering west 5 or 6 overnight, little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate, occasionally rough for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then rain spreading from the west, turning heavy at times, clearing to isolated showers overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
